family.description: This PHM7_ext family is found in plants and fungi. It represents the C-terminal extracellular domain of the putative phosphate transporter, PHM7 [[cite:PUB00063120]]. The three N-terminal TMS are found in family RSN1_TM, [pfam:PF02714]; the cytoplssmic domain is [pfam:PF14703], and the remaining 7TM region is in [pfam:PF02714].
family.name: Extracellular tail, of 10TM putative phosphate transporter
